messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info
function.description: Retrieve information about a particular star in the universe. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × Jupiter’s radius** (about 180,000 km). Its mass is estimated at around **10 × Jupiter’s mass**, making it one of the most massive “hot Jupiters” known.  

(If you’re interested in the largest *brown dwarf*—which sits between planets and stars—the record holder is **HD 130322 b**, with a mass of about 80 M_Jup.)
